name: plagiarize-0.0

repo.description: Configuration for strings, files, and file paths to replace in target file

url.description: Git url of project to plagiarize

checkout.description: Branch, tag, or commit to checkout from project to be plagiarized

description:
Hello team,

Our upcoming integration will be based on the repository located at https://github.com/example/plagiarized-project.git, checked out at the tag v1.2.3. The source project we’re mirroring is called **CoolApp**; it was originally authored by **Jane Doe** in 2023 and is released under the **MIT** license. Please note that the original codebase is not private, so we can freely reference it in our work.

For the configuration variables, use **Acme Corp** as the company name, set the maximum number of users to **1000**, and enable the primary feature flag (i.e., set **feature_enabled** to true). These settings will ensure that the duplicated project aligns with our internal policies and usage limits.
